meta.title: Arena 16: select unchanged answers in 31 jobs

cards.title: Default select: fixed answers, independent judgments
items: This diagram maps the GPT/Codex fork at commit 27c62901a490e2bb4df88aa8e412f91938bf87a5. Click nodes for pinned source evidence.
16 completed drafts + 15 independent judges across four rounds = 31 jobs. An optional blind baseline judge makes 32. Retries and separately requested artifacts add jobs.

Fresh workers get only their generated brief; disable inherited history. Judges must not inspect strategy cards or other judgments. The coordinator never competes, revises entries, judges, or chooses a winner.

Wave size defaults to 1. Confirm capacity and subtract the coordinator and other active work; four total slots allow at most three available workers. Wait for completion, check actual files, then release slots when required.

cards.title: Integrity, saved state and delivery
items: Before the first judge prompts, hash every completed original answer. Prompt generation, collect and advance verify frozen originals; winner_report checks them again. Missing or changed bytes block progress: restore originals rather than re-freezing changed answers.
Each winner keeps its original solution path; later pairings follow adjacent winners from the previous round. No attack or revision jobs exist in select mode.

One coordinator changes arena.json; use the explicit absolute RUN with every command. Worker file restrictions are prompt rules, not an OS sandbox. Applying a proposed project diff remains a separate user decision.
If the blind baseline wins, report it honestly as the preferred answer alongside the tournament result. Deliver the full selected answer, decisive reasons, counts and record location.

cards.title: Bounded failures and what validation proves
items: Strict collect requires finite numeric scores, boolean fatal flags, standing lists and the matching match ID. It quarantines invalid verdicts as .unreadable; only the rubric's result is recorded. Missing outputs stay incomplete.

Ordinary jobs get two total attempts; match and final judges get three. Maintain an attempt ledger under RUN. Retry the final baseline judge under the same bound before delivery. Stop incomplete with failed job and resumable RUN when limits or independent-context capacity are exhausted; never invent outputs or winners.
The diagram's automated artifact and browser checks validate the generated diagram and its source provenance. They do not establish answer accuracy. A bracket winner is not proof of correctness.

cards.title: Optional original mode: explicit --mode evolve
items: Only an explicit --mode evolve adds opponent critiques and revisions: spawn -> attack -> defend -> judge -> collect -> advance. Each match has two attack jobs, two defense/revision jobs and one judge.
16 drafts + 15 matches x five jobs = 91 jobs, or 92 with baseline. Saved runs without a mode retain evolving behavior. This optional mode is outside the main path above.
